description: Match a stone's test readings against the 36 gemstones in Digital Gemology's data and rank them, saying which reading fits and which does not. Give any of: refractive index, birefringence, specific gravity, optic character, pleochroism, a spectrum line, or that the refractometer read over the limit. A match is a lead, not an identification.

birefringence.description: The difference between the two readings, for example 0.008; 0 for a singly refractive stone.

optic_character.description: From the polariscope: singly refractive (stays dark) or doubly refractive (blinks light and dark).

over_the_limit.description: True if the refractometer showed no reading because the stone is above about 1.81.

pleochroism.description: What the dichroscope shows: none, weak, distinct or strong.

spectrum_line_nm.description: A line or band seen in a hand spectroscope, in nanometres, for example 694.

name: identify_gem
title: Match gem test readings
